question: Measure clean-process readiness of the exact Qwen3.8 Flash-Next RCO IQ2_XS Strata 1M YaRN×4 profile with both RTX 3090s assigned.
profile: Strata 0.1.41; max_context 1048576; YaRN factor 4/original context 262144; KV int8; MTP/spec 4; expert-cache auto; dual GPU 0,1.
gpu_topology: GPU0+GPU1; config requests [0,1], and both GPUs must show this run's model allocation/compute at readiness.
cold_definition: First clean process with model absent from VRAM. Do not flush global OS page cache; report cache state as uncontrolled because this boot has earlier model use.
hot_definition: Clean stop and immediate new process with identical config after first load; page cache may be partially warm and is not directly instrumented.
measurement: Monotonic Popen-to-healthy GET /health for each; readiness only, no prompt or generation, not TTFT.
stop_conditions: either GPU lacks dual allocation/compute gate
resource_policy: Sequential only; preserve GUI/PeritoSoft; terminate only the owned process group; no production changes.
dual_gpu_gate_note: At readiness, the same owned process tree must appear as CUDA compute on both GPU0 and GPU1, and each GPU memory use must rise by >1 GiB from its per-run baseline.
